{{TOCright}}
Prove your worth to the [[Luxon]]s by helping their supply routes.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Deliver the [[Luxon Supplies]] to [[Quartermaster Hector]]

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 400 [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
You need to get supplies to [[Quartermaster Hector]], near the entrance to [[Cavalon]]. Kurzick NPCs will ambush you as you go there. Once you reach the Quartermaster, he will be attacked by two [[Scuttle Fish]], so make sure to kill all potential enemies in the area before reaching the Quartermaster.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Supplymaster Keleos
:''"Wonderful. Another outsider expecting favors for nothing. Listen, friend, if you want the Luxons to help you, you'd better be ready to help us first. The [[Kurzick]]s think they can outlast us, but we have enough supplies to last for years to come. The problem? The supplies are here and the troops that need them are on the front lines. The blasted Kurzicks attack every supply caravan I send, and I can't spare the guards to fend them off. We need another way to get the supplies to the front. If you want our help, you just volunteered for the job. Deliver these supplies to [[Quartermaster Hector]], and we Luxons will consider your request for assistance.''
{{offer dialog
|accept = The Quartermaster will have them in no time.
|decline = Do I look like a delivery boy?
|ask = Get moving! '''Quartermaster Hector''' is awaiting those '''supplies'''! 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Quartermaster Hector
:''You have proven yourself a friend of the Luxons. Thank you.

==Notes==
*This quest is useful for increasing [[Vanquisher|vanquish]] numbers with easy kills for the area.
*The Kurzick equivalent is [[Kurzick Supply Lines]].
